**Metadata/licence notice update, no code changes.**

This is an **unofficial** Minecraft 26.3 build of FSit, built from upstream commit `ad12a77353fde8e60861f9436404277ed435b74d` of the `v3/dev` branch at https://codeberg.org/rvbsm/fsit, plus the build fix from the previous release.

FSit is made by rvbsm (Ruslan Mykhailenko) and its contributors (ThatCuteOne, furrymileon, JustAlittleWolf, TheWhiteDog9487, dirtTW) and is licensed under the MIT licence. The licence text is in `LICENSE` and bundled in the jar as `META-INF/LICENSE`. This build is **not affiliated with or endorsed by** the FSit authors. Please report problems with this build at https://github.com/imaron85/fsit/issues, not upstream. Official releases: https://modrinth.com/mod/fsit

### What changed since `v3.0.1-beta.2+mc26.3-unofficial`
- `fabric.mod.json`: the description now says "Unofficial Minecraft 26.3 build by imaron85, not made or supported by rvbsm. Report problems at https://github.com/imaron85/fsit/issues."
- `fabric.mod.json`: the homepage, sources and issues links now point to https://github.com/imaron85/fsit. The mod name, authors and licence are unchanged.
- The version is now `3.0.1-beta.2+mc26.3-unofficial.2`.
- The classes and all other files in the jar are byte-identical to the previous release (same CRCs). Only `fabric.mod.json` differs.

### Changes compared to upstream (branch `26.3`)
- No source changes. This is the upstream Stonecutter `26.3` node.
- Build fix: the release jar includes the `client` source set again.
- The metadata changes above.

### Compatibility and testing
- Minecraft 26.3, Java 25, `fabricloader >=0.18.0`, Fabric API modules. Server-side compatible: vanilla clients can use `/sit`, `/crawl` and `/lay`. The config is `config/fsit.yml`.
- The code was tested for the previous release on Quilt Loader 0.30.2-beta.1 with Fabric API 0.164.0+26.3: dedicated server, vanilla-client join, modded client title screen and join, sit keybind, slab right-click and commands. This release changes metadata only.

SHA-1 of `fsit-3.0.1-beta.2+mc26.3-unofficial.2.jar`: `eeb07387ffe24580c84ae25f8467ce28b17bb4dd`

**Unofficial** Minecraft 26.3 build of FSit, built from upstream commit `ad12a77353fde8e60861f9436404277ed435b74d` ("feat(serialization): move comments to a codec") of the `v3/dev` branch at https://codeberg.org/rvbsm/fsit.

FSit is made by rvbsm (Ruslan Mykhailenko) and its contributors (ThatCuteOne, furrymileon, JustAlittleWolf, TheWhiteDog9487, dirtTW) and is licensed under the MIT licence (see `LICENSE`, also bundled in the jar). This build is **not affiliated with or endorsed by** the FSit authors. Please do not report problems with this build to them. Official releases: https://modrinth.com/mod/fsit

This repository is a GitHub mirror of the Codeberg repository. The `v3/dev` branch here has the same file trees as upstream. One commit message was reworded so that it no longer references an issue in another GitHub repository, so commit hashes differ from upstream after that point (upstream `ad12a77` = mirror `c3c3f62`).

### What changed (branch `26.3`)
- No source changes. The jar is the upstream Stonecutter `26.3` node (`./gradlew :26.3:build`).
- One build fix: since the upstream switch to `loom.nestJars`, the release jar (`shadowJar`) only contained the `main` source set, so the client classes (`FSitModClient`, client mixins, `fsit.client.mixins.json`) were missing. The `client` source set output is now included in `shadowJar`.

### Compatibility
- Minecraft 26.3, Java 25. Depends on `fabricloader >=0.18.0` and Fabric API modules (`fabric-api-base`, `fabric-command-api-v2`, `fabric-lifecycle-events-v1`, `fabric-networking-api-v1`). Built against Fabric API 0.162.0+26.3, tested with 0.164.0+26.3.
- Server-side compatible: no registry entries are added. Seats and rides reuse vanilla entities, so vanilla clients can use `/sit`, `/crawl` and `/lay` on a server that runs FSit.
- Config: `config/fsit.yml` (v3 format, `version: 2`). FSit 2.x `fsit.yml` files are not migrated automatically. They are backed up and replaced with defaults.

### Tested
On Quilt Loader 0.30.2-beta.1 (provides fabricloader 0.19.5) with Fabric API 0.164.0+26.3 in a 217-mod pack:
- the dedicated server starts with no FSit errors
- a vanilla 26.3 client joins, and the server seats it (`/sit`) and makes it crawl (`/crawl`)
- the modded client reaches the title screen and joins
- the sit keybind (Right Ctrl) and right-clicking a slab both seat the player
- `/fsit hands list`, `/fsit teleport` and `/fsit reload` work

Fabric Loader 0.19.5 was not run (the dependency ranges allow it).

SHA-1 of `fsit-3.0.1-beta.2+mc26.3.jar`: `711c8c45adf84ca355929b46998f23eb58c9734c`
